name: Other Gods
overview: Scripture clearly forbids having or serving other gods, emphasizing the exclusive worship of the LORD. God commands His people not to follow or mention other gods, highlighting His unique holiness and power above all so-called gods or mighty ones. The people are warned against sacrificing to false gods or devils, who are unknown and newly introduced, contrasting them with the one true God. This teaching underscores the call to wholehearted devotion to God alone, rejecting all idols and false worship.
